title: Release gate intake and hotpatch prioritization — 2026-03-05
content:
Attendees: Diego Martinez (owner), Arielle Nguyen (SRE), Priya Kapoor (Release Eng), Liam O'Connor (Serving Runtime), + recorder: Maya.

Meeting objective:
- Intake items for next release gate (train v1.12) and explicit prioritization of pending hotpatches. Surface risks, decide canary windows, and assign owners.

Agenda:
1) Quick status of current release train readiness
2) Hotpatch queue triage (severity / customer impact / rollback surface)
3) Canary schedule and metrics to gate rollout
4) Decisions, owners, and timeline
5) Open issues and blockers

Summary / high level decisions:
- v1.12 release gate remains scheduled for 2026-03-19 09:00 PT. Soft freeze on non-critical changes 2026-03-12 23:59 PT.
- Two hotpatches approved for immediate inclusion in the canary (HOT-78, HOT-84). Both marked high-priority but with different risk profiles; HOT-78 will be applied first (limited surface), HOT-84 requires schema migration and is scheduled for late canary testing.
- Canary window: 2026-03-16 02:00 UTC -> 2026-03-16 14:00 UTC. Initial 4-hour small cohort (5% traffic) followed by 8-hour medium cohort (25% traffic) assuming metrics stable.
- Rollback triggers defined: 5xx rate +0.5% absolute over baseline for 10 consecutive minutes OR latency P95 regresses by >200ms for 5 consecutive minutes OR customer-impact alert (pager) triggered.

Detailed notes:
1) Release train readiness:
- QA: smoke tests passing on main branch but two flaky E2E tests still failing intermittently; test owners assigned (see linked artifacts). Decision: flaky tests must be muted and tracked in test-rotation; they will not block gate if root cause ticket created by 2026-03-09 EOD. Owner: Priya.
- Docs: console docs for rollout options updated; need one more review from product. Owner: Liam.
- Dependency check: third-party telemetry agent requires minor bump (infra PR #1432). That PR is green but needs perf-signoff. Perf owners: Arielle + SRE bench team. Deadline 2026-03-11.

2) Hotpatch triage (queue snapshot at start of meeting):
- HOT-78: Serving runtime memory leak in 2.8.1 when KV cache pressure high. Impact: intermittent OOMs under synthetic burst. Customer-facing? yes (internal staging failure, one customer report). Risk: patch is small (1 function) and has unit tests. Recommendation: include in immediate canary. Owner for deploy & monitor: Liam.
- HOT-84: Migration to quantized embedding table format. Impact: minor accuracy drift reported in one dataset, on-prem customers may need attention. Risk: requires DB migration step; downtime planned < 2 min per node with rolling strategy. Recommendation: hold for medium cohort to allow rollback testing and migration dry-run. Owner for migration runbook: Priya.
- HOT-90: UI-only cosmetic bug (low impact). Defer to post-release.

3) Canary plan and metrics:
- Metrics to watch (primary): 5xx rate (per-route), request latency P50/P95/P99, token-generation errors, memory/cpu host utilization, KV cache miss rate.
- Secondary: cost-per-token delta, average tokens-per-request, per-tenant error spikes.
- Instrumentation: add a short-lived tracing span for HOT-78 allocation path; Arielle to add trace by 2026-03-06.
- Canary cohorts:
  * Step 1 (5%): subset of non-critical tenants + internal test tenants. Duration 4h.
  * Step 2 (25%): includes paid tenants with low SLA impact. Duration 8h.
  * Step 3 (100%): ramp after sign-off at gate or earlier if metrics stable; expected time: 2h ramp.

4) Rollback and fallback policy:
- Primary rollback: revert service image to previous release and restart cluster role by role. Estimated rollback time 8–12 minutes to full revert for serving cluster; plan validated by SRE.
- Automatic fallback: route traffic to dedicated-capacity pool if serving-runtime errors exceed threshold for 3 consecutive minutes and rollback has not completed. Owner: Arielle.
- Communication: if rollback triggered, page release-oncall and PM, and update /release-status channel. Template message prepared in Confluence linked.

5) Action items (owner, due):
- Priya: create root-cause tickets for flaky E2E tests and mute in CI (due 2026-03-09).
- Liam: deploy HOT-78 to canary cohort, enable tracing, and verify memory metrics (due 2026-03-16 02:15 UTC).
- Arielle: perf signoff for infra PR #1432 and add trace spans for HOT-78 (due 2026-03-11 and 2026-03-06 respectively).
- Diego: finalize gate checklist and notify product & customer-success for planned maintenance window (due 2026-03-12).
- Priya + SRE bench: run migration dry-run for HOT-84 on staging and validate rollback of migration steps (due 2026-03-15).
- Maya: draft post-canary checklist template and recording instructions (due 2026-03-17).

Open questions / concerns:
- Can we reduce HOT-84 migration downtime further? Priya to explore rolling migration without node restart and report back.
- Are there any SOC/compliance blockers for routing a subset of regulated tenants to canary? Security to confirm; linked ticket: REL-2103.
- Will dedicated pools accept failover without identity propagation issues? SRE to run a short failover smoke on 2026-03-10.

Postmortem prevention notes (pre-emptive):
- Ensure logging for allocation path includes tenant-id and request-id to speed triage.
- Add metric for KV cache compaction count; if compaction spikes may correlate with HOT-78 symptoms.

Retrospective / meeting notes on process:
- Intake felt compressed this cycle; suggestion: open hotpatch intake 10 days before gate next cycle. (Action: Diego to propose change to release cadence doc.)
- Good cross-team alignment on rollback triggers; agreed to add explicit test for rollback path in release rehearsals.

Appendix: quick links and references:
- HOT-78 issue: JIRA HOT-78
- Migration runbook draft: Confluence page (linked_artifacts)
- Infra PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1432

Notes to self (informal):
- Watch memory allocation histogram after first 30m of HOT-78 canary — set an alert with 10min aggregation.
- Remind CS to prepare customer comms two hours before canary step 2.

Next meeting: 2026-03-12 16:00 PT (pre-gate readiness check).

-- end of notes --
